rows.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use

Open source Grok Bot alternative, Bring your own agent and subscription: message Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot and 40+ AI agents as bots on your own computer, from iPhone, Mac, Windows, Linux or terminal. Agent-agnostic and free. Also a Muse and Dots alternative. Built in Rust.

Open-source, self-hosted alternative to Claude Duet: AI coworkers (named agents) with instructions, memory, routines, their own isolated computer, and your approval before they act. Also an alternative to OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot, Manus Cue and ChatGPT agent.
open source grok bot. gawk bots automate your menial work via AI models and build you microapps to manage the outcome, so that you have a false sense of control.
